name: Nakano Corporation
summary: Nakano Corporation engages in the construction and real estate business in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and internationally. The company provides design and construction of factories, large-scale condominiums, hotels, offices, data centers, production and logistics facilities, warehouses, and educational institutions; civil engineering services, including various roads, bridges, and rivers projects, as well as erosion control; and renovation work. It also engaged in real estate rental business; solar and wind power generation businesses; and insurance agency services. Nakano Corporation was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
